items.title: United Parcel Stock Up Over 9% Since Strong Q3: Buy for More Upside?
items.summary: UPS stock has gained in excess of 9% since its strong Q3 results, fueled by profit growth and cost savings. Yet weak volumes and dividend concerns cloud its near-term outlook.

items.title: What FedEx Holders Got Right
items.summary: If you only skimmed the headlines on FedEx this year, the story looked muddled. Freight was spun off, Amazon ramped up as a direct logistics rival, pilots secured a 40% pay rise and facilities were shut as Network 2.0 cut deeper into the footprint. For FedEx shareholders, the return over the past year was 58.9%, including dividends. If you were deciding back in November 2025, which side of that mixed picture would you have trusted?
